note: Both sets contain many vague or invented bindings ("component", "dimension", "right-side component", "base plate/block" attributes not shown on the sheet), but Set A captures more verifiable facts correctly: the drawing scale 1 1/2" = 1'-0" for Module A, the 12'-3 3/4" total length of the Module A member, the 10'-3 3/4" length of the Module B member, the 3/8" through bolt, and the C1/S-301 reference. Set B adds the correct L3X3X1/4 angle callout and correctly places 2'-3 7/8" at the left segment of Module A, but it also misbinds that same 2'-3 7/8" to Module B and invents attributes such as "C1 S-301 component height 7 1/16"", "total assembly height 2'-2 7/8"", and "PV STRUCTURAL MEMBER total height 6 13/16"" from bare dimension strings. Set A's notable error is labeling the members "I-beam" (the sheet calls out angles L3X3X1/4) and assigning 2'-3 7/8" to Module B, but overall it keeps more values tied to the right detail and adds the scale fact the other set misses.
